Shared Online Storage

Connect this browser to the church’s deployed Netlify site so approved staff and the administrator use the same saved church records. On the hosted website, the site address is detected automatically. For a local HTML copy, enter the Netlify website address once on that device.

Checking shared-storage connection…

The server stores shared records in Netlify Blobs. No custom password or environment variable setup is required for the initial deployment. For security, login passwords are not displayed on this page.

Clear saved records removes service records, finance entries, member registrations, first-timer records, and activity history from shared storage. Staff accounts and church settings are kept. Export a backup first if you may need these records.

Shared online mode: when this website is deployed to Netlify, approved logins use the Netlify Functions backend and Netlify Blobs to share church records across devices. Keep login credentials private and export backups regularly. If you open a downloaded HTML file directly, it uses local-only storage unless you connect it to your deployed Netlify website.

Church details

Backup and restore

Export a JSON backup regularly. It contains service records, finance entries, the members directory, and church details. Keep the backup somewhere safe.

Privacy note: on the deployed Netlify website, signed-in records sync through the server backend and Netlify Blobs. A downloaded standalone HTML copy uses local storage unless connected to the deployed site. Export backups regularly and keep credentials private.
